sources.snippet: Download Ministral 3 8B Instruct 2512 for free. Compact 8B multimodal instruct model optimized for edge deployment. Ministral 3 8B Instruct 2512 is a balanced, efficient model in the Ministral 3 family, offering strong multimodal capabilities within a compact footprint. It combines an 8.4B-parameter language model with a 0.4B vision encoder, enabling both text reasoning and image understanding.
